definitions.pct: effect in % of the Normal level (scenario) or of the matched baseline (data) over the same slots
definitions.status: appears = claimed sign and 95% CI excludes 0; weak = claimed sign, CI includes 0; absent = opposite sign, CI includes 0; contradicted = opposite sign, CI excludes 0

training_context.note: within-day runs of the training days' tariff dummies (as the CVAE sees each day)

paper_High_outside_window_mass.note: slots 33-46 = union of the two most frequent training High blocks containing 39-44 (33-44, 35-46); outside the window: 33-38 and 45-46
slots 33-46 = union of the two most frequent training High blocks containing 39-44 (33-44, 35-46); outside the window: 33-38 and 45-46
slots 33-46 = union of the two most frequent training High blocks containing 39-44 (33-44, 35-46); outside the window: 33-38 and 45-46
slots 33-46 = union of the two most frequent training High blocks containing 39-44 (33-44, 35-46); outside the window: 33-38 and 45-46

criteria.windows: Low slots 9-19 = 04:00-09:30 GMT, High slots 39-44 = 19:00-22:00 GMT (lib.effects; REPRO_SPEC section 7)
criteria.cvae_side_effect_in_output: paper High scenario: pre2 (37-38) or pre4 (35-38) 'appears' AND post2 (45-46) or post4 (45-47, 3 slots left in the day) 'appears' (claimed sign, day-bootstrap CI excludes 0)
criteria.data_side_effect: real High blocks, all events: pre4 or post4 significantly negative (CI over event days)
criteria.cvae_side_effect_on_real_event_days: CVAE implied effect on the real event days: pre4 or post4 significantly negative
criteria.cooccurrence: correlation of the CVAE's mean response to High 39-44 with its response to the most frequent training blocks that contain 39-44 (33-44, 35-46) inserted alone; share of the outside-window response located in slots 33-46
criteria.cvae_low_rebound: paper Low scenario: rebound_20_31 and rebound_32_47 both 'appears' (drop)
criteria.data_low_rebound: real Low blocks: far_post_5_12 (5-12 half-hours after the end) significantly negative
criteria.data_high_rebound: real High blocks: far_pre_5_12 (5-12 half-hours before the start) significantly positive
